title: a16z Podcast: Real Estate -- Ownership, Asset, Economy

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The largest asset class in the United States is owner-occupied real estate.
reader_summary.overview: The largest asset class in the United States is owner-occupied real estate, yet options for homeowners accessing this are very binary right now. And when people do “own”, that ownership is often skewed by debt. Of course, debt works out great for some, given their risk profiles and potential upside (if the house keeps appreciating).

key_points.text: The largest asset class in the United States is owner-occupied real estate, yet options for homeowners accessing this are very binary right now.
Of course, debt works out great for some, given their risk profiles and potential upside (if the house keeps appreciating).
And millennials can’t even enter the housing market in the first place.
